sentences.en: Speaking of Switzerland, have you ever been there in spring?
sentences.zh: 说到瑞士，你春天去过那里吗？

sentences.en: If you ironed Switzerland, it would be bigger than Germany.
sentences.zh: 如果你把瑞士熨平了，它会比德国还大。

sentences.en: Switzerland is a very beautiful country and well worth visiting.
sentences.zh: 瑞士是一个非常美丽的国家，绝对值得一游。
